data.action: 遮阳伞下抱高高刨冰，浪花打湿沙滩巾后护住樱花糖浆大笑
data.description: 【海滨祭典沙滩·盛夏】蜜璃穿着粉绿花纹泳装，双手举着堆得极高的彩色刨冰，坐在遮阳伞下笑得停不下来；浪花打湿脚边的条纹沙滩巾，她赶紧把最后一勺樱花糖浆护在怀里。
data.lighting: saturated summer sun and sparkling surf
data.mood: 食欲与恋爱感一起满格的假日
data.promptProse: Mitsuri Kanroji from Kimetsu no Yaiba wears a pink-and-green floral swimsuit with a light wrap skirt, striped beach towel and ribbon sandals. She sits beneath a striped parasol with a mountain of rainbow shaved ice held carefully in both hands. A playful wave reaches the towel, making her protect the cherry syrup with a delighted gasp; her long gradient braids bounce as she laughs at the tiny disaster. saturated summer sun and sparkling surf.
data.title: 甘露寺蜜璃 · 海滨刨冰大作战
